name: Risley Dining
description: Risley Dining is a cozy North Campus dining hall inside Risley Hall, the arts-themed living-learning community. It serves American comfort food in a relaxed, intimate setting.

name: North Star Dining
description: North Star Dining is a large all-you-care-to-eat dining hall on North Campus at Robert Purcell Community Center. It serves a rotating mix of global and American dishes and is a central gathering spot for North Campus students.

name: Robert Purcell Marketplace Eatery
description: Robert Purcell Marketplace Eatery (RPCC) is a sprawling North Campus dining hall offering a wide variety of cuisines, live-action cooking stations, and all-you-care-to-eat options. One of the largest and busiest dining halls on Cornell's campus.

name: Carol's Cafe
description: Carol's Café is a cozy campus coffee shop serving espresso drinks, tea, pastries, and light snacks. A quiet spot to grab a coffee and study between classes.

name: Coal Yard Cafe
description: Coal Yard Café is a casual campus café offering a broad menu including sandwiches, bagels, American breakfast plates, crepes, and coffee. Open weekdays 8 AM–3 PM and weekends 9 AM–3 PM.

name: Mattin's Cafe
description: Mattin's Café is a quick-service breakfast and sandwich spot on campus, popular for morning meals, made-to-order sandwiches, and grab-and-go lunches.

name: Carriage House Cafe
description: Carriage House Café is a campus dining spot offering a rotating mix of meals in a charming historic setting. Ideal for a sit-down lunch or a quick bite.

name: Vet School Cafe
description: Vet School Café is a coffee shop located in Cornell's College of Veterinary Medicine, serving espresso, drip coffee, and light snacks. A quiet retreat on the Vet quad.

name: Alley Cat Cafe
description: Alley Cat Café is a beloved campus spot with a relaxed atmosphere, serving food and drinks Tuesday through Sunday. Open Tue–Sat 9 AM–6 PM and Sun 10 AM–5 PM.

name: Cafe Dewitt
description: Café DeWitt is a Cornell coffee shop serving espresso, lattes, and light bites, nestled in DeWitt Mall in downtown Ithaca. A popular local study spot.

name: The Greenhouse Cafe & Cocktail Lounge
description: The Greenhouse Café & Cocktail Lounge is a unique Cornell dining venue that transforms from a café into a cocktail bar in the late afternoon. Open Mon–Thu 3–11 PM and Fri–Sat 3 PM–midnight. A social spot for evening drinks.

name: Ooy's Cafe and Deli
description: Ooy's Café and Deli is a campus café and deli serving sandwiches, hot food, and a mix of daily specials. A convenient grab-and-go lunch option.

name: Press Bay Cafe
description: Press Bay Café is a bright and inviting café in Ithaca serving coffee, pastries, and light meals. Open Mon–Fri 8 AM–3 PM and Sat–Sun 9 AM–4 PM.

name: The Strand Cafe
description: The Strand Café is one of Cornell's most accessible dining spots, open nearly around the clock (6 AM–1 AM). It serves a wide variety of meals, snacks, and beverages, making it a go-to for late-night food runs.

name: Mac's Cafe
description: Mac's Café is a campus dining spot serving American comfort food, hot meals, and daily specials in a casual, welcoming environment.

name: Atrium Cafe
description: Atrium Café is a campus café located in a bright, open atrium space, offering a mix of hot food, coffee, and snacks throughout the day.

name: Morrison Dining
description: Morrison Dining is the dining hall at Toni Morrison Hall on North Campus, serving a rotating menu of international and American dishes in an all-you-care-to-eat format for North Campus residents.
